name: GlCanvas
brief: A class for the rendering graphic elements with a GL raster engine.

members.name: target
members.signature: Result target(void* display, void* surface, void* context, int32_t id, uint32_t w, uint32_t h, ColorSpace cs) noexcept
members.brief: Sets the drawing target for rasterization.
description: This function specifies the drawing target where the rasterization will occur. It can target a specific framebuffer object (FBO) or the main surface.

params.name: display
params.description: The platform-specific display handle (EGLDisplay for EGL). Set `nullptr` for other systems.

params.name: surface
params.description: The platform-specific surface handle (EGLSurface for EGL, HDC for WGL). Set `nullptr` for other systems.

params.name: context
params.description: The OpenGL context to be used for rendering on this canvas.

params.name: id
params.description: The GL target ID, usually indicating the FBO ID. A value of @c 0 specifies the main surface.

params.name: w
params.description: The width (in pixels) of the raster image.

params.name: h
params.description: The height (in pixels) of the raster image.

params.name: cs
params.description: Specifies how the pixel values should be interpreted. Currently, it only allows `ColorSpace::ABGR8888S` as `GL_RGBA8`.

retvals.description: If the canvas is currently rendering. Ensure that Canvas::sync() has been called before setting a new target.
In case the gl engine is not supported.

notes: If `display` and `surface` are not provided, the ThorVG GL engine assumes that the appropriate OpenGL context is already current and will not attempt to bind a new one.

members.name: gen
members.signature: static GlCanvas* gen(EngineOption op = EngineOption::Default) noexcept
members.brief: Creates a new OpenGL/ES Canvas object with optional rendering engine settings.
description: This method generates a OpenGL canvas instance that can be used for drawing vector graphics. It accepts an optional parameter `op` to choose between different rendering engine behaviors.

params.name: op
params.description: The rendering engine option. Default is `EngineOption::Default`.

notes: Currently, it does not support `EngineOption::SmartRender`. The request will be ignored.
